title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build our enterprise operations platform, which serves adealer network in the automotive sector. The product definition and business rules are in place, and the webfront end is built and running. This person will build the back end, the integrations andthe mobile app, and take the product live. This role is the technical owner of the project: you set the architecture, write the code and hand the work overwith its documentation. You will work directly with the Product Owner, supported by a Junior Full StackDeveloper. We expect a full-time commitment to this project alone for the length of the contract, and regularweekly presence in the office. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR •                   At least 10 years of professional software experience; recent years in a tech lead or architect role while stillwriting code hands-on •                   Software development experience in the automotive sector •                   Product development experience in one or more of these areas: dealer network management, inventorymanagement, ERP, CRM, sales management •                   Having taken at least one enterprise product from architecture to production, alone or with a small team •                   Advanced skills in a modern back-end stack (.NET or Node.js) and relational database design; preferably.NET / C# and PostgreSQL •                   REST API design and OpenAPI; experience with a modern front-end framework (React, Angular or Vue),preferably React + TypeScript •                   Mobile app development experience •                   Role- and scope-based authorization, multi-tenant data isolation, audit trails •                   Business-rule-heavy systems: state machines, approval flows, scheduled and event-driven jobs •                   Experience with queue-based asynchronous integrations •                   Working with automated tests and CI/CD; code review and mentoring a junior developer •                   Able to work on a fixed-term contract and invoice for services •                   Leaving the system ready to hand over: architecture decisions, API documentation, deployment andoperations guides •                   Fluent Turkish and a good command of English NICE TO HAVE •                   Integrations with ERP, e-Invoice / e-Archive, banks, SMS / İYS or call center systems •                   Cloud deployment and data hosting compliant with KVKK (the Turkish data protection law) •                   Using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day work Note: Include your GitHub or a reference project link if you have one,

title: Backend ve Entegrasyon Geliştirici
description: ICterra, Münih, İstanbul ve Ankara'da ofisleri bulunan küresel bir yazılım mühendisliği şirketidir. 30 yıllık yazılım geliştirme deneyimini teknoloji uzmanlığı ve kanıtlanmış metodolojilerle birleştirerek, küresel olarak birden fazla sektörde müşterilerimize yenilikçi çözümler sunuyoruz. 200'den fazla yazılım uzmanıyla, yazılım geliştirme ve test hizmetleri sağlayarak dünyanın en iyi BT ve savunma şirketleriyle stratejik ortaklıklar kuruyoruz. Finans sektöründe faaliyet gösteren müşterimiz ile birlikte yürütmüş olduğumuz projelerimiz için Backend ve Entegrasyon Geliştirici olarak müşteri lokasyonundan full ofis çalışabilecek enerjik ekip arkadaşları arıyoruz. Mobil bankacılık, internet bankacılığı ve sadakat uygulamalarını destekleyen backend servislerinin geliştirilmesinde görev alacak profildir. Ana teknoloji C# / ASP.NET Core olmakla birlikte, ihtiyaç halinde Java / Spring Boot servislerinde de geliştirme yapabilmesi beklenmektedir. Temel beklentiler; BFF ve backend servislerinin geliştirilmesi, Fimple ve diğer banka sistemleriyle entegrasyonların gerçekleştirilmesi, Müşteri, hesap, para transferi, ödeme ve sadakat süreçlerine yönelik servislerin geliştirilmesi, Kimlik doğrulama, oturum yönetimi, işlem doğrulama ve bildirim servisleriyle entegrasyon, REST API, SQL ve ilişkisel veritabanı deneyimi, Mikroservis mimarisi ve servisler arası iletişim konusunda yetkinlik, Git, kod inceleme, birim ve entegrasyon testleri konusunda deneyim, Güvenli kodlama, hata yönetimi, veri tutarlılığı ve işlem izlenebilirliği konularına hakimiyet. Tercihen bankacılık/fintech deneyimi, Fimple veya benzeri ana bankacılık uygulamalarıyla entegrasyon, Kafka, Redis, Keycloak, KYC, CMS, sadakat sistemleri ve REST/SOAP servisleri konusunda deneyimli olması gerekiyor.

title: Senior MERN Developer (React.js + Node.js)
description: About us: Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂 Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives. Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success. The Role: We are looking for a Senior MERN Stack Developer with heavy specialization in React.js and Node.js on behalf of one of our high-growth clients to architect, scale, and maintain high-throughput web applications. In this role, you will take operational ownership of both front-end user interfaces and back-end microservices, delivering seamless, secure, and responsive digital products. You will bridge user-facing features with complex database architectures and cloud infrastructure. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products What we are looking for: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and deploying end-to-end applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. Deep proficiency in modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, asynchronous programming, event loops, and memory management across client and server environments. Deep mastery of React internals, custom hooks, component design patterns, state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or React Query), SSR/SSG frameworks (Next.js is a strong plus), and performance optimization (virtualization, code splitting, Web Vitals). Proven experience architecting scalable RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and/or GraphQL services. Proficiency with middleware design, authentication protocols (JWT, OAuth2, Passport.js), and event-driven architectures. Advanced knowledge of MongoDB schema design, aggregation pipelines, index strategy, performance tuning, and ORMs/ODMs like Mongoose or Prisma. Strong commitment to test-driven development using frameworks like Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress, alongside hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), and AWS cloud services. Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones. Nice-to-have: Experience with Next.js or Remix for production-grade full-stack React frameworks. Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) alongside MongoDB. Experience with vector databases or AI model integration into Node.js backend services. Exposure to micro-frontends or monorepo setups (Turborepo, Nx). Responsibilities: Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack features from initial database schema creation down to polished, pixel-perfect React interfaces. Build secure, high-concurrency microservices and web services, managing integrations with third-party APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication channels. Audit, profile, and optimize application throughput—reducing bundle sizes and rendering overhead on the front end while optimizing database queries and caching layers (Redis) on the back end. Lead architectural discussions, write modular and well-documented TypeScript code, enforce strict testing protocols, and conduct thorough peer code reviews. Collaborate with cloud and DevOps engineers to containerize applications, set up automated deployment pipelines, and maintain system monitoring tools. What we offer: Get paid, not played No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options. Predictable project hours Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients. Flex days, so you can recharge Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify. Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies. Hand-picked opportunities, just for you Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions. One seamless process, multiple opportunities A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments. Compensation Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Project Description Hiredbuddy is seeking an entry-level Full Stack Developer to join our remote team. You'll build and maintain web applications, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and grow your skills in a supportive environment. If you're passionate about coding and ready to make an impact, apply today! Full Description As an Entry Level Full Stack Developer at Hiredbuddy, you will be an integral part of our engineering team, contributing to the design, development, and maintenance of web applications that serve a diverse client base. This remote role is perfect for someone who is eager to apply foundational coding skills in a real-world environment while learning from experienced professionals. You will work on both front-end and back-end components, ensuring seamless user experiences and robust server-side logic. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain responsive web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Vue.js for the front end. Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices using Node.js, Express, or similar back-end technologies. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that follows industry best practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver high-quality features. Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and continuously improve development processes. Troubleshoot and debug applications to optimize performance and ensure reliability. Work with databases (SQL or NoSQL) to design schemas, write queries, and manage data storage. Use version control systems like Git for collaborative development and deployment. Stay updated with emerging technologies and suggest improvements to existing systems. Assist in testing and deployment using CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Heroku). Technologies and Tools Our stack evolves, but currently we rely on: Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Redux, or Vue.js Back-end: Node.js, Express, Python (Django/Flask) or Ruby on Rails Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or MySQL Version Control: Git, GitHub/GitLab Deployment: Docker, AWS, Netlify, Vercel Testing: Jest, Mocha, Chai, Cypress Communication: Slack, Zoom, Jira, Trello Growth and Development At Hiredbuddy, we invest in our team's growth. You will receive direct mentorship from senior engineers, regular feedback, and access to resources that help you advance your skills. We encourage exploration of new tools and technologies, and we provide a clear path for progression to mid-level and senior roles. Your contributions will directly impact the success of our products and the satisfaction of our clients. Work Environment This is a fully remote position, allowing you to work from anywhere within the United States. We value work-life balance and flexibility, while maintaining a strong sense of community through virtual events, pair programming sessions, and open communication channels. You will have the support you need to succeed, whether it's through structured onboarding, regular check-ins, or a dedicated buddy system. If you are ready to launch your career as a Full Stack Developer and make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you. Requirements 0-2 years of experience in full stack development (internships and personal projects count) Proficiency in at least one front-end framework (React, Vue, or Angular) and one back-end language (Node.js, Python, or Ruby) Understanding of RESTful APIs and HTTP fundamentals Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL databases Knowledge of version control systems (Git) Ability to write clean, testable code Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Excellent communication and teamwork abilities Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) Benefits Competitive entry-level salary with performance reviews 100% remote work flexibility Health, dental, and vision insurance Paid time off and public holidays Home office stipend Access to learning platforms and certification courses Mentorship from senior developers Opportunity for career growth and role advancement
